questions.question: Which language should the interactive 3D website use?
questions.rationale: The brief explicitly requests TypeScript where appropriate and names Vite + TypeScript for an empty repository.

options.label: TypeScript
options.description: Typed application code, as requested in the brief.

questions.question: Which frontend framework and rendering stack should be used?
questions.rationale: The brief names a minimal Vite + TypeScript + Three.js project if the repository is empty; the workspace contains no existing application code.

options.label: Vite + TypeScript + Three.js (vanilla)
options.description: A small client-only app matching the brief's empty-repository direction.

options.label: React + Vite + Three.js
options.description: Adds React for component-driven UI alongside Three.js.

options.label: Other
options.description: Enter a different framework or rendering stack.

questions.question: What name should appear in the personalized greeting? Leave blank for a greeting without a name.
questions.rationale: The greeting must be configurable, but the recipient's name is not specified in the brief.

questions.question: Which data stores does this project need?
questions.rationale: The requested experience can be configured and served as a static frontend; no persistence, uploads, or backend operations are specified.

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: All greeting configuration and optional assets are bundled with the static frontend.

options.label: Blob Storage
options.description: Store and serve externally managed media or other uploaded files.

options.label: PostgreSQL
options.description: Relational storage for persistent application data.

options.label: Azure SQL
options.description: Managed relational storage for persistent application data.

options.label: Cosmos DB
options.description: Managed document or key-value storage for persistent application data.

questions.question: Will users sign in to use application features?
questions.rationale: The brief describes a recipient-facing gift page with no sign-in or account features.

options.label: No
options.description: The gift experience is publicly viewable and has no account features.

options.label: Yes
options.description: Users need accounts to access application features.
